name: shopping-agent
description: Search a bounded audited Shopify registry with coverage diagnostics, then use Chrome only after complete zero-result coverage.

interface.shortDescription: Match products across audited Shopify stores.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap-Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.2.2 searches a bounded audited Shopify Storefront registry once, isolates failed or timed-out stores, reports coverage, returns an intent-aware Top 3 using literal lowest-price or merchant-diverse ranking, and uses authorized Chrome only after complete API coverage returns zero products.
defaultPrompt: Use FindCheap-Agent to search the audited Shopify registry once. Always request Top 3: use LOWEST_PRICE for explicit cheapest requests and MERCHANT_DIVERSE otherwise; preserve the returned order, report registry coverage, and use authorized Chrome only after complete zero-result coverage.
